signature: DOUBLE PRECISION FUNCTION DLANHS( NORM, N, A, LDA, WORK )

params.name: norm
params.reference: Specifies the value to be returned in DLANHS as described above.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$. When $N = 0$, DLANHS is set to zero.

params.name: A
params.reference: The n by n upper Hessenberg matrix A; the part of A below the first sub-diagonal is not referenced.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (N,1)$.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: where $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge N$ when `NORM = 'I'`; otherwise, `WORK` is not referenced.

notes: no derivable minimum length for workspace WORK
